dct_description_sm: Towns are urban areas divided into wards. This version is based on the latest MIMU Pcode version 9.4 and information provided by field offices and government departments. Compared to the previous version, it includes one new town named Law Pi Ta was formed in Loikaw Township in Kayah State. The new town name is drawn from the previous village tract name. Place names from General Administration Department (GAD), are available in Myanmar Unicode. Transliteration in roman script by MIMU. Place names are in line with the general cartographic practice to reflect the names of such places as designated by the host governments.
